address: 43 Haishan Road, Banqiao District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Long queues are a common sight in this eatery – and it’s easy to see why. With its nostalgic décor, Hai Shan offers a concise selection of classic Taiwanese dishes. Its braised pork rice features tender, slightly chewy pork cloaked in a gently sweet sauce that soaks well into the rice. The signature fried sparerib soup boasts a clean broth lifted by the natural umami of wax gourd and a peppery note, with soft, boneless pork that is easy to enjoy with rice. Set menus offer good value and the flexibility to upgrade side dishes and soup.
